svg.title: RITCxUofT trading algorithm logic
svg.desc: Connect and preflight, wait for a supported active 300-second heat, then select volatility or ETF trading. Volatility uses analyst forecasts, Black–Scholes edge selection and delta hedging. ETF trading evaluates full tenders or executable baskets. Shared risk checks, fill reconciliation and recovery govern all orders. Positions are closed and reconciled before another heat. Passive tender exits are optional; parity is diagnostic; converters are manual-only.
svg.text: News-driven valuation. Liquidity-aware execution. Reconciled risk.
Require flat positions + no open orders
Trade only in a supported active heat
Equilibrium: RITC × CAD per USD = BULL + BEAR
Read analyst news → low / central / high scenarios
Integrate forward variance; apply forecasts at the right time
Compare Black–Scholes value with ask / bid
Subtract commissions, exit spread and hedge reserves
Take the strongest admissible signal; hedge with RTM
Refresh delta after fills; use hedge bands and exit hysteresis
Require a net edge after fees
Known partial fill → cancel remainder, unwind actual inventory
03 EVERY ORDER PASSES THROUGH SHARED CONTROLS
Volatility: at or before 285, adapted to inventory + latency
ETF: begin close-out at 275 · Stop requests also trigger closing
Flat account + no open orders → finish or wait for the next heat
No automated converters · Parity is diagnostic · Passive execution is opt-in
